name: date-range-picker
title: Date range picker
description: A button that opens two months side by side, with quick ranges such as Last 7 days, a switch to compare with the previous period of equal length, and Cancel and Apply. DateRangePanel shows the same panel inline.

props.name: value
props.description: The applied range (controlled). `null` for none. Leave it out to let the panel keep track.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The range applied at the start when not controlled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the range when Apply is pressed.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Called on Apply with the range, the active quick range, the compare state and the previous period.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called on Cancel. The panel goes back to the applied range.

props.name: compare
props.description: Whether comparing to the previous period is on (controlled). Changes are handed back on Apply.

props.name: defaultCompare
props.description: Whether compare starts on when not controlled. Default false.

props.name: onCompareChange
props.description: Called with the new compare state on Apply, when it changed.

props.name: presets
props.description: Which quick ranges to show, in order. Default all seven. Leave "custom" out to hide it.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The first day of the week, 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday. Default 1 (Monday).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for month and weekday names and the range text, such as "de" or "en-GB". Default "en".

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be picked.

props.name: max
props.description: The last day that can be picked, such as today for data that only goes back.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Return true for days that cannot be picked. A range may still run across them.

props.name: today
props.description: The day the quick ranges count from. Default the real today; pass one to pin it in tests and demos.

props.name: months
props.description: Show one or two months. Default: two, or one when the panel is narrower than about 640 px.

props.name: labels
props.description: Text for other languages. Missing keys fall back to English.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer panel.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popover is open (controlled).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popover starts open when not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new open state.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the button the popover lines up with. Default "start".

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: Classes for the popover panel.

a11y.text: The days form a grid with one tab stop. The arrows move by day and week, Home and End go to the start and end of the week, and PageUp and PageDown move a month (with Shift, a year). Enter or Space picks the start and then the end. The quick ranges are a radio group: the arrows move and pick. In the popover, Tab stays inside, and Escape closes it and puts focus back on the button. Inline, Escape drops a half-picked range.

Each month is a grid labelled by its name, with full weekday names on the column headers. Each day reads its full date, then start or end of range, in range, in the comparison period, today or unavailable. Picked days are aria-selected, and today has aria-current="date". A polite status says what was picked: "Start October 5. Now pick the end date." and then "Oct 5 – 9, 2026, 5 days." The button reads "Date range:" and the range, and has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded. The popover is a modal dialog, so the page behind it is inert.

The popover fades and scales in from 97% over 160 ms. It does not animate when opened with the keyboard, or when the system asks for less motion. Days change colour over 150 ms, and nothing else moves. Under reduced motion every transition is off, and the panel works the same.

Dates are local calendar days (year, month, day) with no library and no milliseconds, so nothing shifts across time zones or daylight saving. Month and weekday names come from Intl for the given locale. Days outside min and max, and days rejected by isDateDisabled, cannot be picked, and quick ranges that would land on them are disabled. All text can be replaced through labels.
